description: Symbolic BFS is breadth-first search over sets of states, each stored as a *binary decision diagram* (BDD): a compact graph that represents a Boolean function over the bits of a state. One step computes the *image* of a whole layer (the set of all its successors) and keeps only the states not seen before. The first layer that contains a goal state gives a plan with the fewest operators, and an empty layer proves that no plan exists. Backward search does the same from the goal set with *preimages* (sets of predecessors). Use it for unit-cost tasks with large but regular state spaces, where BDDs stay small.

papers.authors: Álvaro Torralba, Vidal Alcázar, Peter Kissmann, Stefan Edelkamp
papers.title: Efficient symbolic search for cost-optimal planning
